relationships.subject: paternal PTSD-like stress
relationships.evidence_quote: Paternal stress also decreased BDNF expression level only in female offspring.

relationships.subject: lithium
relationships.evidence_quote: The results of the present study also showed that lithium significantly increased BDNF levels in the hippocampus of male and female offspring with a history of paternal chronic footshock exposure.

key_findings: Paternal footshock stress impaired behavior and memory in adolescent offspring, more in females, and reduced hippocampal BDNF in females
Lithium reversed most deficits and raised hippocampal BDNF
